We proceed by setting the upper bound equal to some parameter $a,$ integrating as usual, and then taking the limit as $a\to \infty .$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{8}{\sqrt[5]{{t}^{13}}}\,\text{d}t & ={lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{1}^{a}\frac{8}{\sqrt[5]{{t}^{13}}}\,\text{d}t \\  & =8{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{1}^{a}{t}^{-13/5}\,\text{d}t \\  & =8{lim}_{a\to \infty }{[-\frac{5}{8}{t}^{-8/5}]}_{1}^{a} \\  & =-5\cdot {lim}_{a\to \infty }{[\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{{t}^{8}}}]}_{1}^{a} \\  & =-5\cdot {lim}_{a\to \infty }(\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{{a}^{8}}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{{1}^{8}}}) \\  & =-5(0-1) \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
